text:
anna: quick check — drafting the modal copy when a team pins (locks) a route to a model. aiming for short, clear CTAs and a straightforward undo path.

anna: initial draft:
Header: Keep model version
Body: Keep this route on the selected model version instead of applying automatic updates. This helps stability but you may miss bug fixes and improvements. See estimated impact on latency and cost.
Help: You can unpin this route later from Route settings.
Buttons: [ Cancel ] [ Keep model ]

mike: nit: prefer "Keep current model" — feels like a user choice not an operation. Add inline "See estimated impact" link to jump to our estimator.

sree: accessibility notes:
- Avoid wording that sounds irreversible.
- Add aria-describedby that points to the undo path in Route settings.
- For screen readers, a short bulleted summary helps: 
  • Prevents automatic model updates
  • May change latency and cost
  • Can be undone from Route settings

zoe: engineering thoughts:
- We can wire an inline expand that shows low/median/high estimates. If we do, call it out in copy exactly: "See estimated impact on latency and cost".
- Also avoid parentheses since they can be awkward for TTS.

microcopy-bot: style checklist:
- CTA labels <= 20 chars.
- Use sentence case for body and buttons.
- No trailing punctuation on CTAs.

anna: updated after feedback:
Header: Keep current model
Body: Keep this route on the selected model version instead of applying automatic updates. This helps stability but you may miss fixes and improvements. See estimated impact on latency and cost.
Help: You can unpin this route later from Route settings.
Buttons: [ Cancel ] [ Keep current model ]

anna: tagging @mike @sree @zoe for a quick final look before I add the small estimator expand and open a PR.

mike: ✅ good to go.
sree: 👍 a11y ok — include aria notes in PR.
zoe: will implement estimator and surface ranges.

anna: thanks all — i'll push the branch and include the aria description in the PR.
